study.question: Does source-group allocation of embedding-table width recover the stronger source click AUC at lower parameter storage and measured inference cost, after uniform halving failed to retain quality? Observation: source g2-r0004-context_only AUC0.6606469405 at32060453 parameters; direct embedding_half0.6577818496; dense_half0.6594732894 with negligible total-storage saving; both_half0.6581939950. Learned random full-width maps0.6583135921 versus source show implementation can lose quality without compression. Alignment and freezing improved full-width results to0.6600539774 and0.6605815720. The latest structural copy full-width control exactly matched source0.6606469405, while structural copy width8 reached0.6591168419 at16166277 parameters. Width-associated loss persists after this operator repair; no receipt locates it to context or item fields.
study.hypothesis: Context and item/action tables have unequal marginal predictive value under the inherited gradient routing. Uniform halving may spend its capacity reduction on a sensitive source group. Keeping one group at16 while narrowing only the other to8 can recover part or all of the uniform8 click-AUC deficit with some storage reduction. This is a prospective, direction-agnostic source-group hypothesis: current evidence does not identify which group should stay wide. Item/action lookup occurs over101 positions while context lookup is per impression, so the two allocations can also have different measured costs. Recovery alone is insufficient for an efficiency claim.

nearest_work.difference: Direct ancestor uses uniform table width8, fieldwise coordinate copying to16, unchanged compressed history/scorer/towers and unused frozen maps. Proposed mixed cells vary the table widths by supplied source group while preserving that execution path. Compare the uniform endpoint receipts rather than attributing prior arithmetic effects to source capacity.

study.proposed_difference: Implement one shared standalone Model source for the four source-group width cells(context,item/action)=(16,8),(8,16),(8,8),(16,16); files differ only in literal CONFIG. Two mixed cells are candidates. Work only on a shallow copy of FeatureMap and deep copy of features, changing embedding_dim alone in that private copy. Concatenate variable raw field widths, compress the same masked100 events to30 slots, then copy each eight-wide field within-field to16, passing16-wide fields through. predictions: Uniform16 and uniform8 new layout controls should reproduce the prior copy16 and copy8 initialized states/forward operators and same-seed results (historical click AUC0.660646940486458 and0.6591168418782398); they are consistency and contemporaneous cost controls, not independent seeds. Unexpected endpoint discrepancies trigger implementation investigation before mechanism interpretation.

At least one mixed cell should recover a material part of the uniform8 deficit. Compute conditional context effects A(16,8)-A(8,8), A(16,16)-A(8,16), conditional item effects A(8,16)-A(8,8), A(16,16)-A(16,8), and interaction A(16,16)-A(16,8)-A(8,16)+A(8,8). Nonzero interaction indicates allocation effects depend on the other group; a single best cell does not establish a mechanism.

Predeclared pilot advancement requires click AUC at least source minus0.0003, total parameters at most95% of unchanged source, model-only p50 at least3% lower than contemporaneous uniform16, and end-to-end throughput no more than2% lower. These are practical pilot thresholds, not statistical noninferiority or significance criteria; retain the full quality-cost table even if no cell qualifies.

Report actual unique table owners, source memberships, dimensions, vocabulary row counts, total/embedding/dense parameters and frozen-map storage. Unique-table embedding storage is sum(vocab_rows * assigned_width); without cross-source aliases it equals16*C+8*I or8*C+16*I. C/I are unique supplied context/item-action vocabulary row sums, not assumed known here. Dense compute is held fixed; parameter savings do not imply latency savings.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary-only mean separately, training seconds, total allocated/wall cost, peak GPU memory, inference seconds, throughput and p50/p95 at fixed batch8192. Report historical history bins(empty,1-16,17-64,>64) with N/positive/negative counts; slices are exploratory and do not choose the primary winner.

Host numerical prerequisites: compare uniform endpoint initialized tensors and predictions with the corresponding archived copy implementation at fixed seed; test batch1 and normal batch, all-empty and partly masked histories, arbitrary masked IDs, unknown current-action invariance, finite outputs and BCE backward. Audit that auxiliary-only losses yield no local_activation parameter gradients and no gradients through the item/action input paths, while context/towers get allowed gradients. For a table tied across sources, a context-path gradient can reach the shared parameter; test path contributions separately and do not assert parameter ownership or zero total shared-table gradient. Ensure frozen maps get no gradient and persistent Dice state changes only through the primary call. Check the host FeatureMap is byte/structurally unchanged after construction. Static checks alone do not establish these properties.
falsifiers: Both mixed cells miss the predeclared retention threshold, or neither achieves meaningful storage reduction: no supported quality-preserving allocation in this tested range.

AUC recovery occurs only in the allocation retaining almost all parameters, or p50/throughput fail the measured cost criteria: capacity recovery may be real but the efficiency objective remains unsupported.
Uniform endpoints fail initialized-state, masking or functional-equivalence checks: resolve implementation/information-boundary failure, and do not treat its outcome as scientific counterevidence.

Conditional effects are unstable under authorized paired repetitions, intervals remain too wide, or gains disappear under a future matched-storage replacement: keep conclusions preliminary and do not establish source-specific mechanism support.
alternative_explanations: Changing table shapes changes initialization and RNG consumption; equal seed is paired protocol, not identical initialization or an independent repetition.
Mixed cells generally have different parameter counts and lookup costs. This is a source-group capacity factorial, not equal-storage evidence that one field family is intrinsically superior.
A cross-source alias retains the larger requested width for all tied uses; report actual unique-table widths and source memberships before interpreting the nominal source contrast.
Eight coordinates copied twice constrain rank and double coordinate reuse; cannot distinguish raw capacity, representation geometry, and optimizer conditioning using this factorial alone.
No raw feature-map vocabulary snapshot or GPU execution is present in this proposal workspace. Exact mixed-cell counts, numerical equivalence, gradients and costs are host prerequisites.
Auxiliary losses can shape context tables while item/action tables are gated; table widths can change optimization under the single-pass recipe rather than irreducible information capacity.

Model-only latency differences may reflect memory layout, kernel thresholds or timing noise. Inference includes all four heads. Gains must be observed in contemporaneous model-only and end-to-end cost views.

The stronger click source already trades away auxiliary quality: source auxiliary AUCs approximately0.6642/0.7096/0.6688 versus baseline0.8491/0.8649/0.8702. This proposal optimizes the specified click criterion and must not claim overall four-task superiority.
Only official_offline histories are available; whole-window vocabularies and delayed-feedback visibility limit production point-in-time conclusions. No test feedback is authorized or used.
